name: compact-button
title: Compact Button
description: A small icon-only button component with variants, sizes, and optional full-radius. Uses namespace exports: CompactButton.Root, CompactButton.Icon.

docs.lead: A small icon-only button component with variants, sizes, and optional full-radius.
docs.usage:
import * as CompactButton from "@/components/ui/compact-button"

<CompactButton.Root variant="stroke">
  <CompactButton.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
</CompactButton.Root>

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: All visual variants: stroke (default with border and shadow), ghost (transparent background), white (solid white with shadow), and modifiable (no default styling, fully customizable via className).
examples.code:
<CompactButton.Root variant="stroke">
  <CompactButton.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
</CompactButton.Root>
<CompactButton.Root variant="ghost">
  <CompactButton.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
</CompactButton.Root>
<CompactButton.Root variant="white">
  <CompactButton.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
</CompactButton.Root>
<CompactButton.Root variant="modifiable" className="text-error-base hover:bg-error-lighter">
  <CompactButton.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
</CompactButton.Root>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Compact buttons come in large (default) and medium sizes.

examples.title: Full Radius
examples.description: Use fullRadius for a circular button shape.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled state removes interactivity and applies muted styling.

examples.title: As Child
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render as a different element, such as a link.

props.name: fullRadius
props.description: Renders as a circle instead of rounded square

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: CompactButton.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon container that receives variant and size from CompactButton.Root.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as
